description:
Every turn + tool telemetry event currently carries `session: pid()`
in its metadata. `OctoPi.Telemetry.Logger.handle_event/4` inspects
the full merged map to a single log line, so pid strings appear in
every line:

    [telemetry] octo_pi_agent.turn.start %{session: #PID<0.466.0>,
    system_time: ..., turn: 1}

The pid isn't useful in logs — sessions aren't correlated across
events that way today, and inspecting pids is noisy.

Options:
1. Drop session from metadata (simplest; breaks nothing because no
   handler uses it).
2. Keep it but have Logger bridge filter pids out when rendering.

Prefer option 1. If we ever want per-session correlation we'll add
a stable session id instead.
title: Trim session pid from telemetry metadata / filter in Logger bridge
